paragraphs: Levi bar Huna bar Ḥiyya and Rabbah bar Rav Huna were traveling on the road. Levi's donkey went ahead, Shabbat (51, end of side b). Rav Yehudah bar Oshaya was peeling a spleen [Ḥullin: טחלא. Heilprin: נוחלא] for him, etc. His father came and said, 'Thus said your mother's father, R. Yirmeyah bar Abba,' Ḥullin (93, end of side a), Shabbat (156a).
